answer: To halt Sybil swarms, nodes anchor cryptographic attestation chains via zero-knowledge proofs atop an ivory trust ledger, ensuring privacy while validating verified compute histories. Rather than allowing fake identities to wander through validation pools, staking requirements scale as an exponential capital exhaustion curve, $O(2^n)$, for coordinated clusters. This forces attacker cost to scale superlinearly, trapping malicious swarms on a barren mesa of prohibitive collateral.
